jobs.title: Technology Strategy Senior Manager
jobs.description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

Position Overview

At the center of Lenovo’s most significant technology strategy initiatives within the CTO Office, the Technology Strategy team bridges the gap between emerging technologies and business strategy. We are seeking a strategic thinker who is passionate about technology, thrives in a fast-paced and intellectually curious environment, and enjoys working across a broad range of research and engineering disciplines.

As a key member of the Technology Strategy team, you will help shape Lenovo’s long-term innovation agenda by supporting strategic planning, executive decision-making, and organizational alignment across the CTO organization. Working closely with leadership and research teams, you will contribute to defining future technology investments and research priorities that drive Lenovo’s competitive advantage.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning Executive Communications

Develop clear, forward-looking strategic deliverables, including technology and market trend analyses, technology outlooks, strategic recommendations, and executive presentations.
Translate complex technical and business insights into concise, actionable content for senior leaders.
Ensure strategy materials are data-driven, decision-ready, and aligned with CTO organization priorities.

Technology Foresight Long-Term Research Strategy

Help define Lenovo’s 2–5 year technology and research focus areas, including domains such as AI models and agents, smart devices, next-generation computing platforms, component innovation, Agent Frameworks, and Agentic Operating Systems.
Conduct external technology and market analysis while assessing internal capabilities and competitive positioning.
Synthesize diverse inputs into prioritized recommendations that inform research roadmaps, investment decisions, and business group alignment.

Cross-Functional Alignment Governance

Partner with RD, engineering, product, and research teams to align strategic priorities, technical requirements, and execution plans.
Support governance processes and executive forums, including annual planning activities, technology brainstorming sessions, and technology committee meetings.
Drive clarity around decisions, ownership, action items, and follow-through across stakeholder groups.

Portfolio Management Execution Visibility

Monitor progress, dependencies, risks, and key milestones for strategic technology initiatives, including flagship AI programs and emerging technology investments.
Identify and escalate issues proactively while facilitating cross-functional resolution.
Maintain leadership reporting, OKR alignment, and portfolio visibility to support informed decision-making and execution excellence.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Technology Management, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
Experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, technology strategy, product strategy, or a related strategic planning function.
Demonstrated knowledge of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, smart devices, semiconductor/chipset technologies, and hardware system innovation.
Proven ability to evaluate complex technology landscapes and develop strategic recommendations for senior leadership.
Strong project and program management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams and stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working across a broad range of technology domains and rapidly learning new technical concepts.
Exceptional analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to assess opportunities, risks, and tradeoffs.
Strong executive communication and presentation skills, including experience developing materials for senior leadership audiences.
Excellent collaboration and influence skills, with a demonstrated ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
Strong business acumen combined with technical curiosity and strategic thinking.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.

jobs.title: FSO - Cybersecurity Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The Cybersecurity Senior Manager (SM2) is responsible for driving strategic cyber solution development, supporting priority account growth, and enabling the successful pursuit and delivery of cybersecurity services across client engagements. This role serves as a trusted advisor to account leadership teams, helping clients address complex cyber risks while identifying opportunities to expand EY Cyber services.

The individual will work closely with client-serving partners, account teams, solution architects, managed service leaders, and global cybersecurity practices to develop differentiated solutions, support pursuits, and position EY as the preferred cyber transformation advisor.

Key Responsibilities:

Cyber Solution Development – Cyber Defense & Fraud

Lead development of integrated cybersecurity solutions aligned to client business objectives and risk priorities.
Design innovative offerings spanning Cyber Defense & Fraud
Lead development of repeatable service offerings, solution accelerators, and implementation frameworks.
Collaborate with sector cyber teams to bring leading practices and emerging capabilities into client solutions.
Develop operating models, service catalogs, staffing plans, implementation roadmaps, and target-state architectures.
Incorporate AI, automation, analytics, and GenAI-enabled capabilities into cybersecurity solutions.

Account Field of Play Support

Serve as the cyber domain lead for strategic accounts across the insurance sector.
Support account teams in identifying, qualifying, and shaping cybersecurity opportunities.
Develop account growth strategies and opportunity roadmaps.
Build trusted relationships with C-suite executives, including CIO and CISO.
Drive executive-level discussions around cybersecurity transformation and business risk.
Maintain account intelligence on client priorities, operating models, technology landscape, and cyber maturity.

Pursuit & Proposal Management

Lead cybersecurity proposal development for strategic opportunities for Cyber Defense & Fraud.
Develop pursuit materials including executive presentations, Statements of Work (SOWs), business cases, cost estimates, transformation roadmaps and managed service solutions
Present solutions during client workshops, orals, and executive sessions.
Support contract negotiations and commercial discussions.
Manage pipeline forecasting and reporting for cyber opportunities.

Client Advisory & Transformation Leadership

Serve as a trusted advisor on cybersecurity strategy and transformation initiatives.
Conduct assessments of cyber operating models, capabilities, and organizational structures.
Advise clients on cyber investment prioritization, service optimization, managed service adoption, workforce transformation and risk reduction strategies
Align cybersecurity programs with regulatory and industry requirements.

Market & Practice Development

Contribute to development of new EY cyber offerings and go-to-market solutions for Cyber Defense & Fraud.
Support thought leadership, client roundtables, and industry events.
Mentor managers, consultants, and solution architects.
Share reusable assets, methodologies, and market insights for Cyber Defense & Fraud across the cyber practice.

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.

Experience

10–15+ years of cybersecurity consulting, advisory, or industry experience.
Demonstrated experience leading large-scale cyber transformation programs.
Proven success supporting sales pursuits and account growth.
Experience developing cybersecurity business cases, roadmaps, and operating models.
Strong understanding of managed security services and security operations.
Experience working directly with CISOs and executive stakeholders.

Preferred Certifications

CISSP
CISM
CCSP
AWS/Azure/GCP Security Certifications

Key Competencies

Leadership

Executive presence and influence
Strategic thinking
Team leadership and coaching
Stakeholder management

Business Development

Opportunity identification
Solution commercialization
Proposal development
Account growth planning
Revenue management

Technical Expertise

Cybersecurity architecture
Cyber operating models
Security services transformation
Cloud and emerging technology security
AI-enabled cybersecurity solutions

Consulting Skills

Executive communication
Workshop facilitation
Problem solving
Storytelling and presentation development
Financial and business case analysis

Performance Expectations

The successful SM2 will:

Drive significant cyber pipeline growth within strategic insurance sector accounts.
Lead development of differentiated cybersecurity solutions for Cyber Defense & Fraud.
Establish trusted advisor relationships with client executives at insurance sector accounts.
Achieve revenue and sales targets aligned to account plans.
Successfully support major pursuits and proposal efforts.
Enhance EY's market position through innovative cyber offerings and thought leadership.

Typical Success Metrics

Cyber pipeline created and influenced
Revenue sold and delivered
Proposal win rate
Executive stakeholder relationships established
Cross-service line collaboration effectiveness
Reusable solution assets developed
Team development and mentorship contributions

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:

New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $204,800 to $425,500
Bay Area California offices – $213,300 to $443,200
All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $170,600 to $390,000

Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
For those living in California, please click here for additional information.

Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
